2609.05913.title: Neuron-Guided Fine-Tuning: Unlocking Efficient Alignment Mechanisms for Large Language Models
2609.05913.paper_summary: Existing Supervised Fine-Tuning paradigms, particularly Full Parameter Fine-Tuning are often plagued by parameter redundancy, inconsistent data quality, and catastrophic forgetting, which current methods typically address in isolation and lack a unified optimization signal to bridge data selection, parameter updates, and knowledge preservation. To address this, we propose Neuron-Guided Fine-Tuning (NGFT), a holistic framework that leverages neuron activation patterns as a universal proxy to unify the fine-tuning lifecycle. NGFT operates via three synergistic mechanisms: (1) Adaptive Task-Specific Neuron Selection, which identifies essential neurons in a single forward pass to concentrate updates and reduce redundancy; (2) Activation-Based Data Selection, which prioritizes information-dense samples that maximize contribution to key neurons; and (3) Neuron Activation Alignment, a novel loss function that anchors activations to pre-trained states, deepening representation learning and preserving general knowledge. Experimental results across three models across both domain-specific and general benchmarks demonstrate that NGFT significantly outperforms existing mainstream fine-tuning methods in both efficiency and performance, while effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
2609.05913.paper_summary_zh: 現有的監督式微調範式，特別是全參數微調，常常受到參數冗餘、不一致的數據質量和災難性遺忘的困擾，當前的方法通常孤立地解決這些問題，缺乏統一的優化信號來橋接數據選擇、參數更新和知識保留。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了神經元引導微調（NGFT），這是一個整體框架，利用神經元激活模式作為統一微調生命周期的通用代理。NGFT 通過三個協同機制運作：（1）自適應任務特定神經元選擇，通過單次前向傳播識別關鍵神經元，以集中更新並減少冗餘；（2）基於激活的數據選擇，優先選擇信息密集的樣本，以最大化對關鍵神經元的貢獻；以及（3）神經元激活對齊，一種新穎的損失函數，將激活錨定到預訓練狀態，深化表示學習並保留一般知識。在三個模型的實驗結果中，無論是在特定領域還是一般基準上，NGFT 都顯著超越了現有主流微調方法的效率和性能，同時有效減輕了災難性遺忘。
